text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hurry, Trainer! The cafeteria is about to close!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the spring Tenno Sho, Mejiro McQueen is in great shape.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Training went off without a hitch again today, so we decided to have a snack in the cafeteria, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt, bzzzt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Oh? A phone call? Who on earth could it—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No, this isn't gonna cut it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I couldn't hold out in the Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen was so amazing right up to the end, but I…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I couldn't…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hey… don't you think you might be training a little too much?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh… Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I thought you left awfully early for it being your day off. I can't believe you've been training by yourself all day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: If you push yourself too hard, your body will break down. You have a race coming up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But… I'm still not good enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro family expected me to win the Classics, but… that's not how it worked out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen flawlessly met everyone's expectations in the Tenno Sho, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm weak… I'm not nearly good enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm not strong enough, not motivated enough—I don't have enough of anything!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …I know how you feel. I've been by you all this time. But wanting to win is all the more reason not to push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: …All right. Sorry for worrying you. I'll go change and then rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Truly?! For my accomplishments?! I feel… You have my eternal gratitude for this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can tell by her voice, she's talking with her grandmother.

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text: …I've been watching your endeavors this entire time. Know that your hard work is what merited this recent achievement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, Grandmother!

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text: Be proud of how radiant you've become. And one more thing.

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text: I am hoping you will pave a new path for our long-established Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What? You want me… to pave a new path?

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text: Yes. The task will be difficult, requiring considerable preparation.

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text: But I know that you'll be fine. Go forward in your own way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-yes…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So, I'm the one who is to show the illustrious Mejiro family a new path? To think Grandmother's entrusted me with such a task…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Have… Have I really? It doesn't truly feel real yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At that exact moment, I spot someone coming toward us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Was that… Grandmother just now? So, she's picked you…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: R-Ryan?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-you must have heard it all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: She really expects that much from you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm not surprised. You won the Tenno Sho, and you're always so strong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You've been like that since we were kids.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Um, but I don't really feel that way yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hm… You'll be fine, McQueen. I know it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You've already lived up to everyone's expectations and showed us a perfect win at the Tenno Sho, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's why I think you're more than worthy of being the family's head. Still!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I wanna get strong too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I don't want all our family's expectations to be on you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What do you say, McQueen? We've got one more!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: One more showdown between us! This time… at the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I won't lose this one. I'll win for sure, and by doing that…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'll prove that I'm strong enough to bear those expectations with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ryan…
choice_data_list: That's what true resolve sounds like.
That's what true resolve sounds like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …It seems so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Apparently, my resolve to shoulder the responsibility of the Mejiro family name is being called into question.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ryan said she'll prove that she's strong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: In that case, I must prove to her how strong I am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The participants in the Takarazuka Kinen are selected by fan ballot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Just to be chosen to compete is a privilege in itself. I hope Ryan knows that.
